fusions.name: Silent Pounce
fusions.desc: Leaps onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away and chops for 13 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of Tall Grass
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. It has 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been wounded yet.

fusions.name: Righting Twist
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Always Lands True
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
